title.en: An Act Appropriating Such Sum or Sums as Meay Be Necessary, in Money of the United states, for the Payment of Interest as It May Become Due Upon the Bounds Authorized to Be Issued By Act Numbered Twenty-Six Hundred and Fifteen.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated from any funds not otherwise appropriated in the Insular Treasury
such sum or sums as may be necessary, in money of the United States, for the purpose of paying the interest
when and as due upon such bonds as may be issued in accordance with the provisions of Act Numbered
Twenty-six hundred and-fifteen.

This Act shall take effect upon its passage.
Enacted, February 4, 1916.
